answer.reason: The verses give a battle of the kings of Canaan at Taanach and Manasseh's failure to drive out its inhabitants, beyond the bare listings.

clauses.english: was where the kings of Canaan fought, by the waters of Megiddo
clauses.quote: fought the kings of Canaan in Taanach by the waters of Megiddo

clauses.english: kept its Canaanite inhabitants, whom Manasseh did not drive out

doubts: JOS 12:21 only lists its king among others; JOS 17:11, JOS 21:25 and 1CH 7:29 only list it among cities or give it as a possession, so they are not used.
The Levite-city verse (JOS 21:25) spells the name Tanach.
